entries.name: toBracketNotationSearchParamTuples
entries.description:
Expands a potentially nested object into bracket-notation query key/value tuples.

Arrays are addressed by index and object properties by key, recursively, so every leaf
gets its own fully-qualified parameter. Nullish leaves are omitted rather than emitted
as the strings `"null"`/`"undefined"`; all other leaves are stringified.

entries.name: makeUrlSearchParams
entries.signature: makeUrlSearchParams(input: Maybe<ArrayOrValue<Maybe<object | Record<string, string | number>>>>, options?: Maybe<MakeUrlSearchParamsOptions>): URLSearchParams
entries.description: Creates URLSearchParams from the input objects. The input objects are merged together.

params.name: input
params.description: - One or more objects (or nullish values) whose key-value pairs become search parameters.

params.name: options
params.description: - Optional configuration for filtering, omitting keys, and space encoding.

entries.returns: A URLSearchParams instance built from the merged and filtered input.

entries.name: makeUrlSearchParamsString
entries.signature: makeUrlSearchParamsString(input: Maybe<ArrayOrValue<Maybe<object | Record<string, string | number>>>>, options?: Maybe<MakeUrlSearchParamsOptions>): string
entries.description:
Creates a URL query string from the input objects.

Equivalent to `makeUrlSearchParams(...).toString()`, but respects the
{@link MakeUrlSearchParamsOptions.useUrlSearchSpaceHandling} option to produce
RFC 3986 percent-encoded output (`%20` for spaces) instead of the
`application/x-www-form-urlencoded` default (`+` for spaces).

params.name: input
params.description: - Objects to encode as query parameters.

entries.returns: The encoded query string (without a leading `?`)

entries.name: updateUrlSearchParams
entries.signature: updateUrlSearchParams(url: string, params: Maybe<ArrayOrValue<Maybe<object | Record<string, string | number>>>>, options?: Maybe<MakeUrlSearchParamsOptions>): string
entries.description:
Updates or adds query parameters on an existing URL string.

Parses the URL's existing query string, merges in the new parameters (new values
override existing keys), and returns the rebuilt URL. Respects all
{@link MakeUrlSearchParamsOptions} such as `omitKeys`, `filterEmptyValues`, and
`useUrlSearchSpaceHandling`.

params.name: params
params.description: - New search parameters to merge into the URL.

params.name: options
params.description: - Optional configuration for filtering, omitting keys, and space encoding.

entries.returns: The URL string with updated query parameters.

entries.name: mergeMakeUrlSearchParamsOptions
entries.description: Merges an array of MakeUrlSearchParamsOptions into a single MakeUrlSearchParamsOptions value.

params.name: options
params.description: - One or more options objects whose omitKeys sets are combined.

entries.returns: A single MakeUrlSearchParamsOptions with the union of all omitKeys.
